evidence_sentence: If the number of tags exceeds the maximum allowed, it returns an error.
rationale: The vulnerable implementation checks `iter > CIPSO_V4_TAG_MAXCNT` before writing, which permits a tag at index `CIPSO_V4_TAG_MAXCNT` and therefore does not reject the first excess tag. The fixed implementation changes this to `iter >= CIPSO_V4_TAG_MAXCNT`, rejecting an excess tag before the write. The additional claim that it fills “any remaining slots” also matches only the fixed implementation, which uses a loop, whereas the vulnerable version writes only one invalid marker.
rewritten_docstring: The function retrieves the DOI from the netlink attributes, validates the nested tag list, and populates the DOI structure with tags from the list. It processes the tag list within the DOI tag storage and marks unused tag storage with an invalid tag value before returning success.
